name: Black Chicken 65
author: 1osm
description: Outlined rounded red button that lifts on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, transform becomes translateY(-10px), background-color changes from transparent to #FF5858.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Black Chicken 65</title>
<style>
/* Black Chicken 65 by 1osm — https://uiverse.io/1osm/black-chicken-65 */
.Btn {
  width: 150px;
  height: 50px;
  background-color: transparent;
  color: white;
  font-weight: bold;
  border-width: 2px;
  border-color: #FF5858;
  border-radius: 20px;
  transition: all 0.3s;
}

.Btn:hover {
  transform: translateY(-10px);
  background-color: #FF5858;
}

.Btn::after {
  transform: translateY(0);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="Btn">Click Me</button>

</body>
</html>
